subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He is first ______ to his job and then to his family.
solution:
The correct answer is: **committed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"committed"** means dedicated or loyal to a cause, activity, or job. (प्रतिबद्ध)

 
 
• **Example:** She is committed to her studies and spends many hours each day in the library.
 
 
 
• In this context, the correct word **"committed"** implies a strong sense of dedication and responsibility.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **committed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enabled** (सक्षम): To give someone the authority or means to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The new software enabled the team to complete their tasks more efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Confirmed** (पुष्टि की): To establish the truth or correctness of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The reservation was confirmed by the hotel.
 
 
 
• **Convinced** (आश्वस्त): To persuade someone to do something or to believe that something is true.
 
 
• **Example:** She convinced her parents to let her go on the trip.
